verdict_rationale: No authority offers the payroll engine a system-to-system integration that Mercans operates. Every outbound submission is made by a third-party filing provider (owner decision; the provider choice is outside the build) through the authority's portal, file upload or electronic return channel; every inbound item is a document the employer acts on. The index records the provider hand-off contract; no authority runbook is warranted.

outbound_integrations: Statutory filing data hand-off to the third-party filing provider (all in-scope federal, State and local returns, deposits and new-hire reports)
New-hire reporting (State Directory of New Hires; electronic two monthly transmissions)
inbound_integrations: Child-support income withholding orders (IWO / e-IWO) from State agencies
IRS notice of levy on wages (Form 668-W) with the employee's exemption statement
State UI contribution rate notices (annual employer rate per State, e.g. AZ UC-603, CA DE 2088, AK TR02)
